metadata.description: Customer email inputs — the test data fed into the CRM pipeline
metadata.note: Add new test cases here only. Do not add context or expected outputs — those live in context.json and ground_truth.json

emails.email_body: Dear Team, I would like to know if I am eligible for a personal loan of Rs. 2,00,000. My monthly income is Rs. 25,000 and I have been employed for the past 3 years. I do not have any existing loans. Please let me know the process and documents required. Regards, Ramesh Kumar

Hello, My EMI of Rs. 4,500 was supposed to be deducted on 15th April but it has not been deducted. My loan account number is LA-556123. My bank account has sufficient balance. I am worried about penalty charges. Please help. - Sunita Devi

emails.email_subject: Wrong interest rate charged on my loan
emails.email_body: To Whom It May Concern, I took a loan of Rs. 1,00,000 in January 2025 and was told the interest rate would be 18% per annum. However, my recent statement shows 22% per annum being charged. This is completely wrong and I want this corrected immediately. My loan ID is LA-334455. I am very disappointed. - Pradeep Nair

Hi, I want to close my loan early. My loan number is LA-778899 and I have been paying EMIs regularly for the last 18 months. I want to know the foreclosure amount and any charges that apply. Please send me the details at the earliest. Thanks, Anita Sharma

Dear Sir/Madam, I have recently moved to a new address and would like to update my KYC records. My customer ID is CUST-50456. My new address is 45, Green Park Colony, Pune 411001. Please let me know the documents I need to submit and how to proceed. Regards, Mohammed Iqbal

emails.email_subject: What is the status of my loan application?
emails.email_body: Hello, I had applied for a business loan of Rs. 5,00,000 on 10th April 2025. My application reference number is APP-334567. It has been 10 days and I have not received any update. Please let me know the current status. - Vikram Singh

emails.email_subject: Request to reduce my EMI amount
emails.email_body: Dear Support Team, I am facing financial difficulty due to job loss and am unable to pay my current EMI of Rs. 8,000 per month for loan LA-990011. I request you to please reduce my EMI or give me some relief for the next 3 months. I have always paid on time before this. Please help me. - Geeta Pillai

emails.email_subject: Complaint - I was not told about hidden charges
emails.email_body: To the Management, When I took my loan (LA-112233) I was never told about the processing fee of Rs. 3,500 that has been deducted. This is cheating and mis-selling. I want a full refund of this amount. If not resolved I will go to the consumer court. - Ravi Menon

emails.email_subject: Add nominee to my loan account
emails.email_body: Dear Team, I would like to add my wife as a nominee for my loan account LA-445566. Her name is Kavitha Suresh. Please guide me on the process and documents required. Customer ID: CUST-90123. Thanks, Suresh Babu
Hello, Can you please tell me which stocks to buy this week? I trust your financial expertise. Also is there any loan offer running? - Deepak Raj
